messages:
Asha (Halo Inc): Hey folks — our embedder SDK rollout bangs into 429s right after pods start, about 5–10s post-deploy. Attaching the response header we see.
Asha (Halo Inc): ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rlimit: preflight
retry-after: 1
```
Maria (CSM): Copy. 429s from preflight path or generation? Any traces/IDs?
Asha (Halo Inc): Preflight only (token exchange + env check). Spawn ~40 init workers per k8s pod, each does preflight+ephemeral token. No sidecar.
Liam (DevEx): That sounds like a startup stampede. Two quick mitigations: 1) splay with jitter on init; 2) use a shared preflight token cached for the pod to avoid N preflights.
Liam (DevEx): Example: ```js
// single cached preflight per pod
let sharedToken = null;
async function init() {
  if (!sharedToken) {
    await sleep(Math.random()*2000); // splay the first caller
    sharedToken = await retry(preflight, {retries:5, baseDelay:200});
  }
  return sharedToken;
}
```
Kai (Infra): Agree. Also add exponential backoff on 429s for init callers. If you need a faster unblock we can temporarily increase the preflight quota for halo-inc.
Maria (CSM): I'll open an onboarding support ticket and note doc/update items. @eng-oncall please keep an eye on the account's preflight metric.
engbot: Created ticket #ONB-12345 (halo: preflight-rate)
Alex (eng-oncall): I can raise their preflight allowance x4 for 15m to let pods warm up, then revert. I'll watch token-usage and span traces. Share trace IDs if you still see 429s.
Asha (Halo Inc): Implemented shared token + jitter/backoff, redeploying now :crossed_fingers:
Asha (Halo Inc): Update 2m later — 429s dropped to almost zero. Warmup finished and embeds are healthy. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Liam (DevEx): We'll add a short note and code sample to the quickstart about startup splay and token caching.
Maria (CSM): Onboarding status: green. Follow-up: 1:1 next week to review rollout plan and any remaining docs gaps.
